module_summary: Bit-stream run-length detector FSM: ten states count consecutive ones on a serial input and decode, after a terminating zero, a five-ones (bit-stuff discard) event, a six-ones flag, or seven-plus ones error.

anchors.name: n14_1f2
anchors.why: State register counting consecutive ones and holding discard/flag/error states.

anchors.name: n9_f1a
anchors.why: Discard indication after five ones followed by zero.

anchors.name: n8_1fc
anchors.why: Flag-detected indication after six ones followed by zero.

anchors.name: n13_00f
anchors.why: Error indication while seven or more consecutive ones are seen.

groups.name: run_detector
groups.description: Ones-counting FSM with decoded discard/flag/error outputs.
